task.title: Navigate the All learning resources page
task.shortdesc: Use the All learning resources page to view and filter all learning resources available on the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console. You can access the All learning resources page directly or from the help panel.

step.cmd: In the Hybrid Cloud ConsoleHybrid Cloud Console, click the Help button to open the help panel, then select the Learn tab.
Click the All learning catalog link. The All learning resources page opens.
Perform any of the following tasks:

ul.li: To filter by product family, content type, or use case, select one or more check boxes.
To find a specific resource, enter the resource name or partial name in the search box.

To bookmark a resource, click the bookmark icon on any resource tile. The bookmarked resources are listed on the My bookmarked resources tab and on the Bookmarked learning resources widget on the home page.
